content:
With the Liquid Glass redesign now rolling out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Here's what we know.

New chat bubble design is more rounded

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more widely, after months of testing and refining the new look with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted hints in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp's chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubble design is starting to roll out to select users on the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo reports:

Besides redesigning the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more seamless.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently available to select users running the WhatsApp TestFlight build. There's no timeline yet for a wider rollout to all iOS users.
